title: Lion cub reading a book
svg:

  <circle cx="68" cy="24" r="4.5" fill="#F7D9A8"/>

  <circle cx="67" cy="74" r="1" fill="#D4791E"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="75" r="1" fill="#D4791E"/>
